**Return a refusal when `run-fixed-worker!` throws before the child starts.**

`host/run-fixed-worker!` can throw `:input-bound` or `:installation` before spawning the worker. `transition!` does not catch these exceptions, so callers receive an exception instead of a `:refused` result.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
--- "a/packages/eta-mu/src/cljs/eta_mu/infra/review_intent.cljs"
+++ "b/packages/eta-mu/src/cljs/eta_mu/infra/review_intent.cljs"
@@ -72,7 +72,9 @@
                      :binding binding
                      :command (cond-> (select-keys command [:state :expected-version :owner])
                                 claim-id (assoc :claim-id claim-id))}
-            raw-result (host/run-fixed-worker! request)
+            raw-result (try (host/run-fixed-worker! request)
+                            (catch :default error
+                              (refused [:worker (or (:intent/error (ex-data error)) :worker-failure)])))
             result (bind-recovery-result store (observed-worker-result raw-result))]
         (if (and (= :appended (:status result)) (= :post-started (:state result)))
           (let [fresh-admission (safe-admission context)]
```

</details>

**Normalize pre-spawn failures in `recover!`.**

A valid recovery request can make `run-fixed-worker!` throw before spawning the worker when the fixed installation is unavailable or the serialized request exceeds 64 KiB. `recover!` then raises instead of returning the structured `:unknown` result with `:capability-issued? false`.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
--- "a/packages/eta-mu/src/cljs/eta_mu/infra/review_intent.cljs"
+++ "b/packages/eta-mu/src/cljs/eta_mu/infra/review_intent.cljs"
@@ -94,12 +94,18 @@
                            (when (map? recovery) recovery))]
       (if-not recovery-map
         (refused :recovery-receipt)
-        (let [raw-result (host/run-fixed-worker!
-                          {:operation :recover
-                           :store (store-key store)
-                           :recovery recovery-map
-                           :append-uncertain? authorized?})
+        (let [raw-result (try
+                           (host/run-fixed-worker!
+                            {:operation :recover
+                             :store (store-key store)
+                             :recovery recovery-map
+                             :append-uncertain? authorized?})
+                           (catch :default error
+                             {:status :unknown
+                              :reason :worker-process
+                              :error-code (or (:intent/error (ex-data error))
+                                              "process-error")}))
               result (observed-worker-result raw-result)
               next-recovery (:recovery result)
               result (dissoc result :recovery)]
           (when (and authorized? (map? next-recovery))
```

</details>
